## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-11-04 05:10 IST to 2026-11-05 05:10 IST

One newly reported, credible vulnerability matched the normalized primary product inventory. The mandatory MongoDB ecosystem sweep found no new, credible MongoDB-related vulnerability in the same 24-hour window.

### CVE-2026-76506 — Cisco UCS Central remote code execution

- **Affected product/component:** Cisco UCS Central Software; the Canadian Centre for Cyber Security identifies versions prior to 2.1(2c)
- **Severity:** High — CVSS 7.6
- **Description:** Insufficient validation of user-supplied input in the web management interface could allow an authenticated remote attacker to send a crafted HTTP request and execute code or disclose sensitive information on an affected system.
- **Why relevant:** The monitored inventory explicitly includes Cisco UCS, and UCS Central is part of that product family.
- **Source:** [Cisco Security Advisory](https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-cucs-rce-LzHSFRDQ); [Canadian Centre for Cyber Security advisory AV26-1127](https://www.cyber.gc.ca/en/alerts-advisories/cisco-security-advisory-av26-1127)

**Closing:** Immediate review is recommended because Cisco rates the issue High and successful exploitation can result in remote code execution. Confirm whether UCS Central is deployed and compare its release with Cisco's fixed-software guidance.
